offense_strengths: Explosive run game with Derrick Henry breaking big runs and scoring multiple TDs
Lamar Jackson's dual-threat ability with designed runs, scrambles, and accurate deep/middle passes to multiple receivers
Effective play-action and misdirection leading to open TDs
Big plays through the air to Zay Flowers, Rashod Bateman, and tight ends
defense_weaknesses: Allowed multiple big passing plays to Dallas receivers including deep shots and TDs
Vulnerable to run game allowing 20+ yard rushes
Missed tackles in space on big gains

offense_strengths: Explosive plays through run game with Javonte Williams and KaVontae Turpin scoring TDs
Dak Prescott's ability to make big throws downfield to CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens, and Jake Ferguson for TDs
Resilient scoring drives including game-tying FG
defense_weaknesses: Struggled to stop Baltimore's run game, allowing multiple big runs and TDs by Henry
Defensive pass interference penalties costing big yards and setting up scores
Blocked field goal and fumble turnover
Injuries impacting secondary and run defense
